scope: research-only reconstruction of two margin-closeout failures, four consecutive manual winners, and the immediate post-close open-position boundary

frozen_cohort.selection: all two same-day margin closeouts plus the next four consecutive positive manual closes; no row may be added or removed after replay

truth.transactions: read-only OANDA transactions/sinceid; sanitized exact fill/order facts
truth.path: complete OANDA S5 bid/ask candles, bounded to the first 40 minutes from each entry
truth.context: complete OANDA M5 and H4 bid/ask candles available before each decision
truth.costs: actual baseline P/L; counterfactual side-correct bid/ask plus adverse half-spread exit stress; observed commissions and financing retained
truth.missing: remain null or WAIT; never zero-filled

causality.operator_parameters: derived only from the four explicitly identified manual wins and labeled in-sample

acceptance_tests: exact six frozen closed trades and one open NO_TOUCH boundary
every counterfactual exit uses a post-entry complete S5 executable side
no arm changes actual units or calls a broker mutation method
all four arms use exactly the same six cohort ids
independent oracle reproduces metrics from row-level receipts
